fields.label: Company
fields.description: Denormalized from chat_session.company so permission_query_conditions can filter rows without a join, matching every other Company-scoped doctype in this app.

fields.label: Sender ID
fields.description: frappe.session.user for Human, the resolved agent_profile for Agent, or a fixed system label.

fields.label: Content (sanitized)
fields.description: The human-readable message text only — never a raw model prompt, system instruction, or tool payload. See services/chat_response_transformer.py.

fields.label: Content Hash
fields.description: sha256 of content_sanitized, same hashing convention as services/idempotency.py.

fields.label: UI Blocks (JSON)
fields.description: The typed CortexChatBlock list this message rendered as — see cortex_rental/schemas/chat_schemas.py.

fields.label: Model Name
fields.description: Informational only, never trusted for authorization — same convention as Cortex Agent Run.model_used.

fields.label: Routing Reason
fields.description: Why AgentRouter/the model router picked this provider/agent — see docs/design-system.md's chat spec "Routage Gemini et Sonnet". Not populated by MockOnyxChatClient beyond a fixed placeholder string in this pass.

fields.label: Estimated Cost (USD)
fields.description: A rough estimate for observability, not a billing record — deliberately not a Currency field, which would overstate its accounting significance.

fields.label: Request ID
fields.description: Correlates to the same request_id used by Cortex Agent Run/Cortex Agent Tool Call for this turn.
